clues.text: On "我的推广", "新建推广" does not reliably activate through act_ui. Verify exactly one visible DOM button by text and context, then dispatch one full pointer/mouse sequence.

The budget section may show "高峰日上调" and "预算耗尽上调" inline; their display-only amounts recalculate from 基础预算. If an info-icon drawer is present, each toggle has its own "确定" confirmation and the drawer uses "保存设置".

After switching promotion type, "日期和时间" may collapse; expand its title once. Open the time editor with the uniquely verified DOM summary pencil, not row text. The editor contains "全选", a 7×24 grid, "已选择时段", and "保存修改".

After dual-platform mode is confirmed, identify 基础预算, "点评", and "美团" inputs once and set them together with one bounded native-setter DOM mutation plus input/change events. Verify numerically; 1.30 may display as 1.3.

The 7×24 grid needs full pointer events. Map rows to hours 0-23 and columns to 周一..周日. Clear the entire grid, select only decision days/hours in one batch, and leave unmentioned days unselected. Treat 10:00-20:00 as rows 10-19; verify "已选择时段", then save.

The 极速推/标准推 cards expose selection with a "checked" class and do not reliably activate through act_ui. Verify the unique visible DOM card, use one full pointer sequence, then re-check its "checked" state.
In the date picker, the outer day cell may ignore clicks. Verify the displayed month and target day, then dispatch one full pointer sequence to the unique innermost DOM date node.
Open "更多设置" with its uniquely verified DOM pencil icon; the row or label may do nothing. Its drawer contains 曝光渠道, 地域拓量, and "保存设置".
The visible "推广通" li.merchant-menu__item does not reliably activate through act_ui. Verify exactly one visible DOM item with normalized text "推广通" and use one bounded pointer sequence directly.
The DOM text "切换为双平台出价" opens "确认切换吗？" with "仍要切换" and "暂不切换". These controls do not reliably activate through act_ui; verify each unique visible DOM target and use one pointer sequence.
